name: fullcycle
description: Gestor de Tarefas: frontend Angular, API NestJS e PostgreSQL no Docker

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/criar-env.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run banco && concurrently --names API,FRONTEND --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:api" "npm:frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix frontend -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
scripts.test:e2e: npm run banco && npm run test:e2e --prefix api
